## 三小时课堂：构建可审计的城市数据管线

本单元把社区人口、养老设施和边界数据组织为分析表。每一步都输出检查结果，连接失败和重复键会立即停止流程。

### 第一小时：读取、字段契约与主键检查

```{.python filename="07_step1_schema.py"}
import pandas as pd
import geopandas as gpd

population = pd.read_csv("data/raw/community_population.csv",
                         dtype={"community_id": "string"})
communities = gpd.read_file("data/raw/communities.gpkg")

required = {"community_id", "population", "elderly"}
assert required.issubset(population.columns)
assert population["community_id"].is_unique
assert communities["community_id"].is_unique
assert (population[["population", "elderly"]] >= 0).all().all()
```

学生检查编码、单位和数据年份，并把字段契约写入README。若社区代码含前导零，读取时必须使用字符串类型。

### 第二小时：属性连接与空间连接

```{.python filename="07_step2_join.py"}
base = communities.merge(
    population,
    on="community_id",
    how="left",
    validate="one_to_one",
    indicator=True,
)
print(base["_merge"].value_counts())
assert base["_merge"].eq("both").mean() >= .98

facilities = gpd.read_file("data/raw/elderly_facilities.gpkg").to_crs(base.crs)
matched = gpd.sjoin(facilities, base[["community_id", "geometry"]],
                    predicate="within", how="left")
print(matched["community_id"].isna().mean())
```

未匹配设施先制图检查。位于边界线上时可测试 `intersects`，但必须记录规则变化，不能仅为提高匹配率随意更换谓词。

### 第三小时：生成指标、数据血缘和输出

```{.python filename="07_step3_publish.py"}
facility_count = matched.groupby("community_id").size().rename("facility_n")
analysis = base.join(facility_count, on="community_id")
analysis["facility_n"] = analysis["facility_n"].fillna(0).astype(int)
analysis["facilities_per_1000_elderly"] = (
    analysis["facility_n"] / analysis["elderly"].replace(0, pd.NA) * 1000
)

analysis.drop(columns="_merge").to_file(
    "data/processed/community_supply.gpkg", layer="community_supply",
    driver="GPKG"
)
```

输出同时附带行数、缺失率、坐标系、处理时间和输入文件版本。课堂最后由同伴随机抽查三个社区，手工核对设施数。

::: {.lab-brief}
**课堂提交**：字段契约、连接审计、未匹配点地图、处理后GeoPackage和数据血缘说明。代码运行成功只代表技术完成，人工抽查用于验证语义正确性。
:::
